title: Nourishing Norwegian Egg White One-Pot
description: A hearty and filling one-pot dish made with egg whites, lamination puff pastry, and a touch of Norwegian flair. This tamasic-friendly recipe is perfect for a satisfying breakfast or snack.

ingredients.name: Lamination puff pastry
ingredients.notes: Ayurvedic tamasic-friendly option: use puff pastry with no added preservatives or additives.

ingredients.name: Salted butter
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, salted butter for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Sea salt
ingredients.notes: Use a finely ground sea salt for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Fresh dill
ingredients.notes: Add fresh dill on top of the dish for a pop of flavor and color.

ingredients.name: Garlic powder
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality garlic powder for the best flavor.

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of salted butter in a large, oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped fresh dill and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the egg whites and stir gently to distribute evenly.
Place the thawed puff pastry on top of the egg whites and fold the edges under to create a crust.
Cook for 5 minutes, until the pastry is golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15-20 minutes, until the pastry is golden brown and the egg whites are set.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with sea salt and garlic powder.
Serve hot, garnished with additional fresh dill if desired.
